name: MoreYoga Bethnal Green
summary: A yoga and Pilates studio in a railway arch on Gales Gardens, E2. Its classes range from energetic flows to gentler yin, restorative and sound healing sessions.
crowd: The studio says beginners and experienced practitioners alike are at home there.

cost.notes: Offers memberships that can be used at every MoreYoga studio.

from high-energy Dynamic flows like Rocket, Power, and Pilates to Stress-Free classes including Yin, Restorative, and Sound Healing

Beyond the mat, it is a local hub, connecting neighbours through community events, sharing circles, and workshops.
this corrugated arch space has become a warm, minimalist urban oasis, with soft ply-panelled walls, floating paper lantern lighting, and plenty of room to breathe.
Hidden just off the local streets through brick alleyways
